title: Account of an expedition to the interior of New Holland
sourceTitle: Account of an expedition to the interior of New Holland
author: Fox, Mary, Lady · Richard Whately
description: "Account of an Expedition to the Interior of New Holland" edited by Lady Mary Fox is a historical account written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: The work chronicles the journey of explorers who venture into the interior regions of Australia, discovering a previously uncontacted civilization of European origin that had been isolated for centuries.

authorInfo.bio: Fox, John, Jr. (1862–1919) is the author of Hell Fer Sartain and Other Stories. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
